description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLanguageAPI, which is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It tests various endpoints and functionalities such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee language records using mock objects to simulate dependencies.
external_files: Test data and mock classes (e.g., EndpointTestCase, MockObject, TestDataService)

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeLanguageAPI endpoints in OrangeHRM, covering get, create, update, delete operations, and validation rule checks.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data into the database for EmployeeLanguageDao testing.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Verifies that the API returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee language record by ID, including successful retrieval and not-found scenarios.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rules for the getOne API call, including authorization checks and validation of input parameters.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all language records for an employee, ensuring correct data and total count.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the getAll API operation, especially employee ID validation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee language record, including successful creation and handling invalid input.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates input data rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee language record, including successful update and not-found scenarios.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee language records, verifying the deletion process and exception handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the delete operation's input parameters and rules.
